name: grid-type-to-edit
knownIssue: Typing on a focused cell starts editing but drops the first character: beginEditingFocused(with:) sets currentEditor()?.string right after editColumn, but in the view-based grid the cell's text field only becomes first responder later, so currentEditor() is nil (ResultGridView, being rewritten by another agent).

steps.note: type to replace its value, as in a spreadsheet
